excited_bounce.desc: body bobs at 2 Hz (bow pulses 0 -> +0.10, the z slot is dead on the stand net), beak up, head wags left-right at 1 Hz; a quack on every top

excited_hops.desc: five bow pulses (pitch 0 -> +0.15) every 0.55 s, the head flips left/right on each, beak up; a quack on each pulse

excited_jumps.desc: two crouch-then-pop jumps (bow +0.22 released fast) with the head thrown up (beak -0.8) and a quack on each pop, then a fast wag with three chirps

excited_wag_pump.desc: head wag +-0.6 accelerating (6 swings), the body bobs (bow pulse +0.12) on each swing, the beak rises higher and higher, ends with a bow flourish; a quack on each swing
